audit: Round 2: every value re-graded by how its source was actually read. No src/ change.
about: Evidence-backed reference values for Special Force 2. Research data only; nothing here is applied to src/ automatically.

status.confirmed: Original source read directly AND either an official text or two independent directly-read sources agree.
status.provisional: Original source read directly, but only one source (or a pre-release build).
status.unverified: Only seen through a search-engine or model summary; the original page was not opened.
status.estimated: Our own calculation; carries a stated error. Never SF2 data.
status.unknown: No usable evidence. Do not fill with assumptions.

access.direct-read: raw page text read by us
access.model-summary: page fetched but read through a summarising model

legend.uiRating: SF2 shows four 0-100 bars per gun. They are relative UI scores; no evidence ties them to HP damage or RPM. EU wiki shows recoil as 100 − real; Inven 반동 is the real value.

origin.designDefault: values in src/ that have no SF2 evidence

regression.model: RPM = b × fireRateRating + a (ordinary least squares)
regression.inputStatus: All four RPM samples are unverified (EU wiki search snippets).

riflesOnly.note: Dropping the single DMR changes the slope by 11%: M14EBR is a high-leverage point and inflates R².

withG36C.note: The G36C wiki RPM (782) sits 221 RPM above the line; its own DPS implies ≈545. Excluded as a likely wiki error.

assault.note: Only class with more than one point; LOO errors −8 to +22 RPM.

dmr.note: One point; it anchors the low end of the line.

smg.note: No data. P90 (86) and MP5K (92) are above the fitted range.

lmg.note: No data. Ratings 64-67 are inside the numeric range, but there is no evidence LMGs follow the rifle line.

shotgun.note: These show fire-rate 0; the formula does not apply.

regression.allowedUse: Interpolation for assault rifles with ratings 61-78 only, labelled estimated, error ±25 RPM (LOO). Never for SMG, LMG, sniper, pistol or shotgun; never presented as SF2 data.
